title: scanning-appsec-pipeline-gate input
description: ADVISORY — documents the assembled stage input; the engine validates workflow input and stage OUTPUTS only (engine/validation.py). Shape below is the POST-adapter payload delivered at stage appsec-scan.

appsec_scan_context.description: From workflow input (optional): OPTIONAL runner context for the T7 AppSec gate (live runner mode). Absent in replay. All refs are non-secret.

sbom_ref.description: SBOM reference — REQUIRED: the integrated gate cannot certify CVE cleanliness without SCA evidence.

files_generated.description: COLLISION (documented): picked from BOTH implement stages; the engine merges last-writer-wins, so this top-level field is the FRONTEND manifest only — a hint, never the enumeration source. Resolve BOTH full artifacts via upstream_artifacts['backend-implement'/'frontend-implement'] and scan the union. A per-producer nested shape is reserved for a future contract.

idempotency_key.description: engine-injected: the workflow's single idempotency key, injected into every stage payload.

upstream_artifacts.description: engine-injected: map of producer stage id to its artifact path relative to this stage's dir.

loop_back_feedback.description: engine-injected (conditional): reviewer findings threaded into a re-run after a loop_back.
